name: Metronome
desc: Every 30 seconds one of your attacks turns into another at random.
rules: Every 30 seconds, one of your attacks swaps for a random one of the same level.
The new attacks come from the kits of the whole League.
Your first attack and Bill's fusions never change.

name: Dynamax Wilds
desc: Every wild Pokémon is a giant: twice as big and as tough, but slower.
rules: Wild Pokémon are twice as big and have twice the HP.
They hit 50% harder, but move 15% slower.

name: Candy Fever
desc: Double experience and PokéDollars, but Pokémon get strong much faster.
rules: You earn double experience and PokéDollars.
Pokémon gain HP and damage over time 60% faster.

name: Crystal
desc: You deal double damage, but you only have a quarter of your HP.
rules: Your max HP drops to a quarter.
